AzureAd.// ClientCredentials: How this API proves ITS OWN identity to Entra for the on-behalf-of exchange that turns a caller's token into a Graph token for that same user (Teams channel lookup, Outlook reminders). Set up by IT Security 2026-09-17, DEV ONLY: a federated identity credential on the 'Origination API - Dev' registration (ClientId in the base file) bound to the app-origination-dev-eus SYSTEM-ASSIGNED managed identity, token-exchange audience api://AzureADTokenExchange. No secret anywhere — the App Service signs an assertion with its own identity. ManagedIdentityClientId is deliberately omitted (system-assigned). QA got the same shape 2026-09-21 (see appsettings.QA.json); Production carries the block too, and its credential + consent were requested for 2026-09-22 (see appsettings.Production.json). Only works ON the App Service: there is no managed identity on a laptop, so locally the Graph calls degrade to empty/no-op and the features stay dormant.

ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: Intentionally absent. DP contracts read ODSConnection above (Dev ODS), exactly like every other ODS query — no cross-environment override anywhere. The DP Contracts tab stays empty in Dev until ODS loads ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1; that is a data gap, not a config gap, and needs no code or config change when the data arrives. Do not add an override pointing at another environment's ODS: it would also require IT/DBA to grant this app's managed identity read access there, which is deliberately not in place.

AppAccess.// GroupId: Deployed Dev reads the DEV access group. Active — the app-origination-dev-eus managed identity has the scoped-group read + User.ReadBasic.All grant (2026-07-28), so usage-dashboard filtering is live here.

CustomerSync.// Source: Customers (producers and their trade-unit links) come from the CTRM customer master in Dev, not the ODS views: the nightly sync reads customers(sourceCodes:) plus a trailing window of contracts and tickets for new links, the add-a-customer search reads the master with the industryCode1 / nameContains / sourceCodeContains filters (confirmed on the gateway 2026-10-20), and onboarding goes by producer code with ids minted from dbo.CustomerIdSequence. Before the first non-dry run in this environment: grant UPDATE on dbo.CustomerIdSequence to the azrscosqld01-Origination-db_datawriter group the app writes through (scripts/Grant-CustomerIdSequence.sql; there is no per-identity database user) and run POST /api/diagnostics/customer-sync/run?dryRun=true&source=ctrm once. Rollback without a redeploy: App Service setting CustomerSync__Source = ods (restarts the app; the ODS feeder adopts minted rows by ScoularId).
CustomerSync.// CtrmExtendedFields: On: all fourteen Stage 2 fields resolve on the nonprod gateway (2026-10-20), so the sync fills email, the extended address, the NOP id and PaymentMethod (the ACH badge reads that column on the ctrm source). Must be on together with Source = ctrm, or the badge goes blank.

Ctrm.// Source: CTRM for everyone in Dev since the 2026-10-06 go-live: every contract and ticket read comes from the Scoular GraphQL API, no toggle. Rollback without a redeploy: App Service setting Ctrm__Source = ods (restarts the app; the switch re-reads config per call).
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: QA gateway, not apidev — QA is the environment the API was validated against and the client secret is a shared nonprod credential. Reachable per developer-docs/NETWORK-DIAGRAM.md: APIM traffic needs NO custom NSG outbound rule because the APIM private endpoint IPs are already allowed.
Ctrm.// ClientSecret: NOT set here and never should be. Supplied from kv-orig-dev-eus as secret 'Ctrm--ClientSecret' (Key Vault maps '--' to ':'), read by the App Service managed identity — the same path every other secret in this environment uses. Unused while UseManagedIdentity is on; kept in the vault as the rollback until QA and PROD are also on the managed identity.
Ctrm.// UseManagedIdentity: ON in Dev first (2026-10-23): CTRM tokens come from app-origination-dev-eus's managed identity (7ff98598-94a0-42cb-81d9-87a6200cb3d9), not the shared nonprod secret. Rollback without a redeploy: App Service setting Ctrm__UseManagedIdentity = false.
Ctrm.// TradeUnitContractBatchConcurrency: 4 on the nonprod gateway, not the base file's 8 — same measurement and reason as appsettings.QA.json (2026-09-29): 8 batches at once lose every one to HC0045 in the gateway's slow phase, 4 get through. Dev, QA and local laptops all share this gateway and identity.
Ctrm.// KeepWarmMinutes: 0 (off) on the nonprod gateway from 2026-10-27, not the base file's 5. The CTRM team reported the GraphQL jobs loading Db2 in Testing and PROD, and keep-warm was ~96% of our calls (QA App Insights, 2026-10-26); 15 minutes was tried first (2026-10-26). Off, CTRM calls follow real use: a trade unit reopened within about two cache TTLs is still served from the cached copy while it refreshes, and one opened cold waits for the full read. Trial for whether cold loads are acceptable before turning it off in PROD. Applied to Dev and QA together so the CTRM team sees one before/after on the Testing gateway. Revert to 15 (or 5) if cold Build-a-List loads are too slow. An App Service setting Ctrm__KeepWarmMinutes overrides this, but changing an app setting restarts the app.

SecurityHeaders.// SpaConnectSrcHosts: cms-dev.scoular.com is the Contracts API (Dev) that the Contract Workspace at /cws calls straight from the browser, with a token our own sign-in gets for it (environment.dev.ts, cws.apiUrl). Without it every CWS call is blocked by connect-src. Harmless while contractWorkspaceEnabled is off.
SecurityHeaders.// SpaCallingConnectSrcHosts: ACS Calling SDK origins for the incoming-call popup, from Microsoft's ACS network-requirements page (*.skype.com, *.microsoft.com, *.azure.net, *.azure.com, *.office.com) plus the ACS resource host and the websocket forms. The trouter signalling socket has been seen on port 3443, hence the explicit :3443 entry (a CSP host without a port matches only the scheme's default port). Inert until Acs:Endpoint below is set. Known widening of connect-src for Dev only; recorded in SECURITY-REVIEWS.

Acs.// Endpoint: acs-origination-dev-eus (rg-origination-dev-eus, scoular-apps-nonprod), provisioned by Infrastructure 2026-10-27 with local auth DISABLED — Entra only, no key anywhere. The app-origination-dev-eus system-assigned MI holds 'Communication and Email Service Owner' directly on it (Infrastructure, 2026-10-27) — a direct assignment, which is what ACS requires (it ignores roles granted through groups). FortiGate egress rule staged; confirm the FortiManager push with Infrastructure if the exchange times out from the deployed API but works locally. See docs/application-context/TEAMS-CALLING-GUIDE.md.
Acs.// TeamsClientId: Origination - Dev (the SPA registration). Tenant-wide admin consent for ACS Teams.ManageCalls + Teams.ManageChats was granted on it 2026-10-27.
